cicd_findings.title: pull_request_target trigger in add-to-project.yml
cicd_findings.description: 'pull_request_target' runs with a write-scoped token and access to repository secrets. This workflow does not check out the PR head (common for labeling/triage automation), but the trigger remains a sensitive surface: any future step that executes PR-controlled content gains access to secrets.
cicd_findings.recommendation: Prefer the 'pull_request' trigger. If write access is required, never check out or execute PR-controlled code in the same job, and gate execution on a maintainer label.

findings.title: Restrictive license: cairosvg is LGPL-3.0-or-later
findings.description: 'cairosvg' uses LGPL-3.0-or-later (weak-copyleft). This imposes obligations (source disclosure of modifications, license preservation) when the project is distributed.
